memory_candidates.content: When a full deploy-headless.sh/verify-deploy.sh run during a multi-task /orchestrate cycle surfaces a gate failure outside your own edited files, check `git status --short <path>` (uncommitted foreign modification), `git log --oneline` (no commit of yours touches it), and the suspect sibling task's status in specs/state.json (e.g. `implementing` = actively in flight). If all three point to a concurrent sibling, document the finding (plan Reasoned Exclusions + summary Plan Deviations) rather than fixing the foreign file -- it is that sibling's own in-progress work, not a regression from your edits.

In orchestrator-context-budget.json's eager_load block, only baseline_bytes gates verify-deploy.sh's Gate 20 Sub-check B; measured_bytes/measured_at/note are purely informational snapshots that may be refreshed freely without moving the ceiling. A stale or erroneous prior measured_bytes value (e.g. one that no longer reproduces even against its own recording commit) should be corrected as a snapshot refresh, not treated as a regression requiring a baseline bump.
